summary: Read two strings, s and p, built only from lowercase letters. The string p is not empty, and neither string is longer than 20100. Search s for every contiguous slice that uses each letter the same number of times as p, even when the letters sit in another arrangement. Write every starting index of those slices. Any order of the indexes is acceptable.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
